item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We must act now to prevent a future in which national security depends on whoever controls the most powerful AI.

2. We cannot defend our countries with yesterday’s assumptions. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We need international safeguards before that threshold is crossed.

3. We stand for a world where countries can protect their people. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most will lose that ability. We must put security ahead of the race to build systems more powerful than we can control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe national security demands confronting a stark reality: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We cannot accept a future in which the power to protect our people rests with a handful of actors controlling technology that outmatches our defenses. We must make preventing that future a priority now, not after these systems are deployed. That means demanding enforceable international safeguards, meaningful oversight, and an end to treating unprecedented capabilities as an ordinary commercial race. We stand for security that countries can uphold—and we will push for the decisions needed to preserve it.
